note.en: Verified 2026-09-20 against the official IB 'DP passing criteria' core points matrix. Read as matrix[TOK grade][EE grade]. A grade E in either TOK or the EE is a failing condition, so the whole E row and E column are FAIL. Official worked example: TOK B + EE C = 2 points.
note.zh: 2026-09-20 对照 IB 官方「DP passing criteria」的 Core points matrix 核实。读法为 matrix[TOK 成绩][EE 成绩]。TOK 或 EE 任一为 E 即失败条件，因此整行整列 E 均为 FAIL。官方示例：TOK B + EE C = 2 分。

failMsg.en: A grade E in TOK or the Extended Essay is a failing condition: no diploma is awarded.
failMsg.zh: TOK 或 EE 出现 E 属于失败条件：不予文凭。
